decisions.reason: Proposes common endodermal-remnant origin for suprasellar neurenteric, Rathke and colloid cysts on histological/immunohistological grounds; needed to weigh endodermal vs paraphyseal origin of colloid cysts (clinical).

Turtle pineal vascular corrosion casts that explicitly study vascular relations with dorsal sac, paraphysis and third-ventricle choroid plexus; pineal is the principal subject and paraphysis is one compared structure (anatomy/physiology); borderline A if full text gives paraphyseal vascular data.
Reissner's fibre/SCO glycoprotein effect on cultured chick neurons; no link to paraphysis or telencephalic roof.
Evans-blue BBB mapping of subfornical organ in rat and duck; circumventricular organ paper never relating to paraphysis.
Letter on three sisters with colloid cysts (familial clinical report); no abstract, no origin/histogenesis content indicated.
Familial colloid cyst case report with generic note on associated congenital defects; no paraphyseal or histogenetic data.
Perinatal interhemispheric cysts with tela-choroidea-like lining over third-ventricle roof; callosal dysgenesis pathology, no paraphysis link.
Seasonal secretory activity of reptilian SCO; SCO paper with no comparison to paraphysis in abstract.

Nieuwenhuys lungfish chapter (metadata only, citation via other paper); may treat telencephalon impar / paraphysis vs coronarium; resolve by checking chapter text for paraphysis/dorsal sac/coronarium.

Whole 3-volume comparative reference; no information on what it says about the paraphysis; resolve by checking index/chapters (lungfish, amphibian, reptile) for paraphysis and then cite the specific chapter.

Reelin mRNA expression in turtle embryonic brain; no paraphysis or roof content.
